A drink which removes {{Health|-|20}} and restores {{Energy|+|80}} when consumed. Infusion can be crafted at the [[Alcohol distiller]] in the [[Cellar]] and is needed for a quest with [[Vagner]].

==Quest==
===Write a song to Ms. Charm===
[[Ms. Charm]] asks you to write her a song. Since you are no poet, you can't do it yourself. You know a poet though, so you ask [[Vagner]] if he is willing to help his love. He immediately agrees to write not just any song - but the best song he's ever created. To do that he needs a special kind of creative boost, and requests a unique recipe he heard about from the University. 1x{{Item|Booze}} and 3x{{Item|Red mushroom}}, mixed at the [[Alcohol distiller|Alcohol Distiller]], should do the trick. Brew this mix and bring it to [[Vagner]]. He will chug it, smile widely and ask to wait. Come visit him the next day.
